summary: The DoJ has charged 28 green card holders in California, accusing them of fraudulently registering to vote.
The US Department of Justice has charged 28 green card holders in California, accusing them of fraudulently registering to vote and casting illegal ballots.

The arrests – 11 people are in custody – mark the latest escalation in federal efforts against alleged noncitizen voting.The crackdown comes days after the DOJ sued California to block the state from tabulating certain ballots in November’s midterms.
